name: station-website-check
description: Check a local business's website the way a customer would: mobile site, online booking, payments, chat, email sign-up and after-hours contact, with what's missing and how to fix it.

interface.longDescription: Station Website Check opens a local business's public website in a real browser and checks what a customer can do there: whether it works on phones, and whether visitors can book online, pay online, chat or message, join an email list or reach the business after hours. It reports which of these look solid, which are missing (with what it saw, why it matters and a plain fix), and which it could not check. It only reports what it actually saw: if a site doesn't load, or is built in a way the checker hasn't been verified on, it says so instead of guessing. It checks the website only, not the Google listing, reviews or phone lines.

positive.description: Owner asks to check their site
positive.prompt: Can you check the website for Mibella Nail Lounge, mibellanaillounge.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Takes about 30 seconds and reports which checks look solid, which are missing with what was seen, why it matters and a fix, and which could not be checked, noting it is a website-only check.

positive.description: Why isn't my site bringing customers
positive.prompt: Why isn't brosibrotherspoolservice.com getting me more customers?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the check and explains the missing items (for example online payments and an email list) in plain language with fixes.
Returns the website check for the bakery's site, or, if the checker is not confident about this site, says it is not reporting results and why, without inventing findings.

positive.prompt: Check katybeergarden.us and tell me what customers can't do there.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the check and lists what is missing for customers on that site.
Reports that the address does not resolve or the site could not be loaded, and makes no claims about the business.

negative.prompt: Build me a website for my plumbing company.
What keywords should my dental practice rank for?
What is the difference between Wix and Squarespace?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or services and does not process payments. It returns a website check and nothing else.
